capabilities: Insert headings, lists, code, tables, images, links, math, and highlight blocks via a slash menu
Convert, cut, duplicate, move, delete, and copy links for whole blocks
Apply bold, italic, strikethrough, highlight, inline code, and links from a floating toolbar
Set block text color, background, alignment, and list indentation
Group images into 1-4 column rows with draggable width ratios stored in callouts
extras: Installation is manual: download main.js, manifest.json, and styles.css from GitHub Releases into the plugins folder; the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Recommends Live Preview and says to disable the core Slash commands plugin if they conflict. Notes limits: code, math, and tables cannot be type-converted via the menu, and complex nested content is better edited as raw Markdown.
problem: Editing in Live Preview spreads these actions across separate core commands and menus, with no block handles, floating toolbar, or visual control over block color, alignment, and image grouping.
summary: Editing toolkit that adds a slash menu for inserting content, block-level actions, a floating selection toolbar, callout type switching, and multi-image layout in Live Preview.
